decks.notes: This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy through various forms of control, utilizing cards like Force of Will, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Terminus to counter threats and control the board. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The inclusion of Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath provides card advantage and a powerful threat. With a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw, this deck focuses on outlasting the opponent and controlling the pace of the game to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Grief and Faithless Looting, then bring them back onto the battlefield with cards like Entomb and Reanimate. By using the combo of graveyard manipulation and reanimation, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize. The deck has a strong focus on speed and efficiency in bringing back high-impact creatures to dominate the game.

The deck focuses on quickly reducing its own life total to maximize the power of Death's Shadow, a key creature in the deck. It also utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to control the board while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. The deck is able to quickly adapt and respond to different situations thanks to the cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm, as well as the ability to counter spells with Force of Will and Daze. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and put pressure on the opponent while staying ahead in tempo.

The main idea of this Mono Black Combo deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by using cards like Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Opposition Agent. The deck also focuses on using Orcish Bowmasters and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to control the board. The key combo pieces in this deck are Helm of Obedience and The One Ring, supported by cards like Dark Ritual and Agadeem's Awakening. Leyline of the Void helps to shut down graveyard strategies, while Karn, the Great Creator provides utility and board presence. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and control the game through disruption and powerful creatures like Sheoldred.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to maintain control of the game through a combination of cheap removal spells like Lightning Bolt and efficient counterspells like Force of Will. The deck aims to pressure opponents with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Daze and Wasteland. By utilizing card selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder, the deck can consistently find its threats and answers to maintain an aggressive tempo and ultimately secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to establish a strong early game presence with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Anointed Peacekeeper, supported by disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void and Solitude. Using fast mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents and maintain control of the board with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The land base is optimized for speed and consistency, allowing for explosive starts and powerful plays throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. It utilizes cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to find and recur key combo pieces, while also running disruption spells like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect the combo. The deck also includes cards like Fury and Lightning Bolt for additional removal and disruption, with accelerants like Lotus Petal and Mox Opal to speed up the combo. Urza's Saga is used to find crucial artifacts, making the deck a fast and resilient combo deck in the Legacy format.

The main concept of this combo-storm deck is to quickly generate mana through cards like Chrome Mox, Lotus Petal, and Lion's Eye Diamond, while using cards like Dark Ritual and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to assemble the necessary pieces for a powerful storm turn, utilizing cards like Ad Nauseam and Tendrils of Agony to generate a large storm count and finish the game. The inclusion of Wishclaw Talisman and Infernal Tutor allows for additional card selection and searching for key combo pieces. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient in executing its win condition.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gaining incremental advantage through card draw and recursion with cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Life from the Loam. By efficiently managing resources and utilizing versatile spells like Prismatic Ending and Force of Will, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent until it can secure a victory through a combination of board control and incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts, particularly blue ones, to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm opponents with aggressive strategies. Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Kappa Cannoneer, and Sai, Master Thopterist provide strong creature support, while cards like Thought Monitor, Chalice of the Void, and Urza's Saga offer additional utility and power. The inclusion of cards like Lotus Petal, Mox Opal, and Mishra's Bauble allow for ramp and card advantage. Force of Will provides protection, while the Urza lands and other mana sources ensure consistent casting of spells. Overall, the deck aims to establish dominance through fast artifact-based aggression.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing Cascade mechanics to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into high-impact spells like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. The inclusion of counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation helps to protect the deck's key threats while maintaining a disruptive element. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Endurance and Brazen Borrower for additional flexibility and disruption.

The deck is focused on assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo, using Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist to mill cards and generate infinite loops. Thassa's Oracle serves as the win condition, while disruption and protection are provided by cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also includes utility cards like Stoneforge Mystic to search for equipment, Brainstorm for card filtering, and Urza's Saga for additional value. By combining efficient combo pieces with versatile spells, the deck aims to quickly assemble its win condition and disrupt opponents' strategies.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the card Doomsday to set up a winning combination of cards, typically Thassa's Oracle and a way to draw or manipulate your library to win the game on the same turn. It aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to win the game through a powerful combo sequence, using cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Personal Tutor to accelerate the process and disrupt opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and disruption spells like Thoughtseize.

This deck aims to utilize the synergy between Mystic Forge and various artifact cards to quickly assemble a game-winning combo. By using cards like Voltaic Key and Basalt Monolith to generate infinite mana along with Paradox Engine to untap all artifacts, players can cast Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or other powerful spells from the top of their library. The inclusion of Defense Grid and Karn, the Great Creator helps to protect the combo and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to search for key pieces and mana acceleration from cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to maintain tempo and pressure on the opponent. It aims to quickly deploy threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt for additional damage and removal. The deck's mana base is built around fetching for specific lands to ensure consistency and to disrupt the opponent's mana base with Wasteland.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering spells, removing threats, and drawing cards. It utilizes a variety of counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler. By disrupting the opponent's game plan and generating card advantage, this UWx Control deck aims to outvalue the opponent and eventually establish control of the game.
